name: @cinatra-ai/lint-policy-agent
description: Deterministic OAS lint policy agent — runs the platform's policy scanners (literal secrets, untrusted URLs, llm-bridge wiring, llm metadata, StartNode required, package version sync, license) and returns a normalized ReviewFinding[]. The only agent allowed to emit `severity: "blocker"`. Dispatched synchronously via A2A by `agent_source_lint`, `agent_source_publish`, and `agent_source_compile`. See docs/developer/chat-agent-authoring-review.md.
